models.name: todo_app_system_settings
models.description: Global system configuration key-value pairs used to control platform-level behavior (feature toggles, operational thresholds, and public defaults). Settings are administrated by platform operators and can be queried for runtime configuration. Does not duplicate domain prefixes. Temporal fields provided for audit and soft-delete.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Canonical setting key (unique). Examples: "maintenance_mode", "default_list_visibility".

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Serialized setting value stored as string. Consumers are responsible for interpretation (boolean, JSON, numeric) based on the key.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-friendly description explaining purpose and acceptable values for the setting. Useful for admin UIs and audit.

plainFields.name: is_public
plainFields.description: Whether this setting is visible to non-admin audiences (e.g., public telemetry or informational flags).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when active.

models.name: todo_app_feature_flags
models.description: Feature flags used by the platform to gate functionality. Each flag has a canonical key and rollout controls. Administrators can search, enable/disable, and partially roll out flags. Descriptions support full-text search for admin UX.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Canonical feature flag key (unique). Example: "new_onboarding_flow".

plainFields.name: enabled
plainFields.description: Whether the feature flag is currently enabled (global on/off).

plainFields.name: rollout_percentage
plainFields.description: Optional staged rollout percentage (0-100) used by rollout systems to progressively enable features.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Administrative description and notes for the feature flag; used in admin UIs and searchable by maintainers.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when active.

models.name: todo_app_public_index_preferences
models.description: Per-list public indexing preferences that control whether an individual list is discoverable or indexed by platform discovery and external search. Each preferences row is a 1:1 subsidiary record tied to a list {@link todo_app_lists.id}. Managed via list-level operations or admin UI.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_list_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged list's {@link todo_app_lists.id}.

plainFields.name: indexing_enabled
plainFields.description: Whether platform-level indexing is enabled for this list (controls discovery pipeline).

plainFields.name: allow_search_engine
plainFields.description: Whether to allow external search engines to index the public list content. Only applicable if the list is public.

plainFields.name: allow_discovery
plainFields.description: Whether the list may be surfaced in internal discovery (search/explore).

plainFields.name: index_scope
plainFields.description: Optional administrative scope tag for indexing (e.g., "global", "region:eu", or custom collection) to help routing indexing pipelines.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when active.

models.name: todo_app_guest
models.description: Representation of an unauthenticated visitor (guest) for audit, preferences, and lightweight identification. Guests are not authenticated actors and therefore do not have session records in this schema. Used for recording guest-specific metadata, referral tracking, and limited audit trails. Relates indirectly to lists and public interactions via other components. {@link todo_app_lists.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when active.

plainFields.name: anonymous_label
plainFields.description: Optional transient label for display purposes (non-authenticated).

models.name: todo_app_todouser
models.description: Authenticated end-user account for todoApp. Extended to include authentication lifecycle and security fields required by business rules: failed login counters, last failed timestamp, password reset tokens and expiry, refresh token revocation marker, and optional MFA metadata. These additions enable DB-level support for lockout (5 attempts/15min), password-reset-driven token invalidation, and MFA opt-in while preserving existing relationships to lists, sessions, invitations, collaborators, and audit logs.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Primary email address used for login and notifications; unique per account.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for authentication; never store plaintext.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User-facing display name for search and UI.

plainFields.name: is_verified
plainFields.description: Whether the user has verified their email address.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Account lifecycle status (e.g., pending_verification, active, suspended, pending_deletion, deleted).

plainFields.name: failed_login_attempts
plainFields.description: Rolling count of recent failed login attempts. Application logic should reset this on successful authentication or after lockout window expiration.

plainFields.name: last_failed_login_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent failed authentication attempt; used to enforce rolling lockout windows (e.g., 5 attempts within 15 minutes).

plainFields.name: password_reset_token
plainFields.description: Opaque token issued for password reset flows. Null when no reset is pending.

plainFields.name: password_reset_expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiry timestamp for the password reset token.

plainFields.name: refresh_tokens_revoked_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp after which previously issued refresh tokens are considered revoked. Set when password changes or admin revokes sessions to force re-authentication across devices.

plainFields.name: mfa_enabled
plainFields.description: Whether multi-factor authentication is enabled for the account (opt-in). Defaults to false.

plainFields.name: mfa_secret
plainFields.description: Encrypted or reference to MFA secret/seed for the account. Nullable when MFA is not enabled; secure storage and access controls required.

plainFields.name: mfa_backup_codes
plainFields.description: Serialized, encrypted backup codes for MFA recovery; stored only when MFA is enabled.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last account modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when active.

models.name: todo_app_todouser_sessions
models.description: Session records for todo_app_todouser. Each row represents a single session/connection for an authenticated todo user. Sessions are subsidiary and intended for audit, session listing, and revocation flows. Fields strictly follow Actors component session pattern. Relation enforces referential integrity to todo_app_todouser.id.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todouser_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged todo user {@link todo_app_todouser.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the session actor.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL (href) where the session originated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for the session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation time.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiry time; nullable for sessions that do not have a pre-set expiry.

models.name: todo_app_admin
models.description: Administrative actor accounts for platform moderation and operational tasks. Admins have elevated privileges for moderation and must be auditable. Store authentication fields as hashes and record lifecycle timestamps. Admin actions and audit logs are recorded in other components. {@link todo_app_admin_actions.id}.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Administrator email used for login and official communications; unique per admin account.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for admin authentication.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Admin display name for audit and UI.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: Admin role or scope identifier (e.g., moderator, support, superadmin).

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether the admin account is active and allowed to authenticate.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when active.

models.name: todo_app_admin_sessions
models.description: Session records for todo_app_admin. Each session references a single admin actor and contains connection context for auditing and session revocation. Adheres exactly to the session table pattern required by the Actors component.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged admin {@link todo_app_admin.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the admin session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL (href) for the admin session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for the session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation time.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiry time; nullable when session is indefinite or managed externally.

models.name: todo_app_lists
models.description: User-owned todo lists. Stores list metadata and visibility. Each list is owned by a user in the Actors component ({@link todo_app_todouser.id}). Lists are primary business entities enabling independent CRUD and sharing operations.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todouser_id
foreignFields.description: Owner user reference. {@link todo_app_todouser.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: List title. Non-empty user-provided name for the list.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional list description or notes.

plainFields.name: visibility
plainFields.description: List visibility setting (e.g., 'private','shared-invite-only','public').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when active.

models.name: todo_app_tasks
models.description: Tasks that belong to a todo list. Each task references its parent list ({@link todo_app_lists.id}). Tasks are primary business entities with lifecycle and completion metadata. Added optional priority field (business enum: 'low','medium','high','urgent') to satisfy functional requirements.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_list_id
foreignFields.description: Parent list reference. {@link todo_app_lists.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Task title. Required short text for the task (1..200 chars enforced at application layer).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description of the task (max 4000 chars enforced by application).

plainFields.name: is_completed
plainFields.description: Completion flag.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: When the task was completed; null if not completed.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for scheduling and sorting.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Optional priority value. Business enum: 'low','medium','high','urgent'. Nullable if not provided.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when active.

models.name: todo_app_task_tags
models.description: Canonical tag dictionary for tasks. Tags are managed independently to enable consistent tagging across tasks and lists.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Tag name. Case-normalization is recommended at application level.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when active.

models.name: todo_app_task_tag_relations
models.description: Junction table for many-to-many relationship between tasks and tags. Enforces one assignment per (task, tag) via a composite unique constraint. Managed as a subsidiary table.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_task_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced task. {@link todo_app_tasks.id}.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_task_tag_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced tag. {@link todo_app_task_tags.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Assignment creation timestamp.

models.name: todo_app_task_snapshots
models.description: Append-only snapshots capturing the point-in-time state of tasks for audit and historical queries. Each snapshot references the original task ({@link todo_app_tasks.id}). Added optional actor and session attribution to support auditable change traceability.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_task_id
foreignFields.description: Original task reference. {@link todo_app_tasks.id}.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todouser_id
foreignFields.description: Optional acting user who caused the snapshot. {@link todo_app_todouser.id}.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todouser_session_id
foreignFields.description: Optional acting session that triggered the snapshot. {@link todo_app_todouser_sessions.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Task title at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Task description at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: is_completed
plainFields.description: Completion flag at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Completion timestamp captured in the snapshot, if any.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Due date captured in the snapshot, if any.

plainFields.name: original_created_at
plainFields.description: Original task created_at value for historical reference.

plainFields.name: snapshot_created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was taken.

plainFields.name: version
plainFields.description: Monotonic snapshot version number for the task.

models.name: todo_app_invitations
models.description: Invitation records for list collaboration. Captures inviter, optional invitee (registered user), invitee email, an opaque invite_code, human message, lifecycle state (pending/accepted/declined/expired), expiry timestamp (14-day business rule), and audit timestamps. Adjusted to enforce uniqueness for registered-user invites to prevent duplicate invitations to the same user for the same list.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_list_id
foreignFields.description: Target list. {@link todo_app_lists.id}.

foreignFields.name: inviter_todouser_id
foreignFields.description: Inviter user. {@link todo_app_todouser.id}.

foreignFields.name: inviter_todouser_session_id
foreignFields.description: Inviter session for audit/tracing. {@link todo_app_todouser_sessions.id}.

foreignFields.name: invitee_todouser_id
foreignFields.description: Invitee when the invited user is already registered. {@link todo_app_todouser.id}.

plainFields.name: invitee_email
plainFields.description: Email address used to send the invitation when invitee is not yet registered.

plainFields.name: invite_code
plainFields.description: Opaque invite code used for acceptance links. Business-unique token.

plainFields.name: message
plainFields.description: Optional human message included with the invitation.

plainFields.name: state
plainFields.description: Invitation lifecycle state: 'pending', 'accepted', 'declined', 'expired'. Consider enforcing as enum at application/DB level.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp enforcing the 14-day expiry business rule.

plainFields.name: accepted_at
plainFields.description: When the invitation was accepted (if accepted).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update time.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for recoverable audit.

models.name: todo_app_list_collaborators
models.description: Collaborator membership records linking a registered user to a list. Enforces one membership per (list, user), stores assigned role (read-only/read-write), acceptance timestamp, who added the collaborator, and audit timestamps. Added a list-scoped composite index to optimize list->collaborators queries.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_list_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced list. {@link todo_app_lists.id}.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todouser_id
foreignFields.description: Collaborator user. {@link todo_app_todouser.id}.

foreignFields.name: added_by_todouser_id
foreignFields.description: User who added the collaborator. {@link todo_app_todouser.id}.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: Collaborator role: 'read-only' or 'read-write'. Consider enforcing as enum.

plainFields.name: accepted_at
plainFields.description: When a pending collaborator accepted membership (nullable if added by owner and not pending).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update time.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp.

models.name: todo_app_collaboration_permissions
models.description: Canonical permission definitions used by collaboration features. Stores permission code, human description, and metadata. Supporting table used by application logic to validate and present permission choices.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Permission code (e.g., 'list.read', 'list.write').

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-friendly description of the permission.

plainFields.name: is_grantable
plainFields.description: Whether this permission can be granted to collaborators.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation time of the permission record.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update time.

models.name: todo_app_list_shares
models.description: Public share metadata for lists. Stores share token, optional public URL, visibility flags, expiry, and audit timestamps. One-to-one with {@link todo_app_lists.id} to represent the list's public share entry.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_list_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced list for the public share. {@link todo_app_lists.id}.

foreignFields.name: created_by_todouser_id
foreignFields.description: User who created the public share. {@link todo_app_todouser.id}.

plainFields.name: share_token
plainFields.description: Opaque token used to validate share access (unique).

plainFields.name: public_url
plainFields.description: Optional public URL for the list (consumer-facing).

plainFields.name: is_public
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether the list is currently public.

plainFields.name: visibility
plainFields.description: Visibility semantic ('public'|'shared' etc.) for application use.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Optional expiry for the public share.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp.

models.name: todo_app_audit_logs
models.description: Centralized audit log capturing system-level and domain events (visibility changes, exports, deletions, moderation flags). Append-only snapshot of events for forensic analysis and compliance. References actors (admins or users), sessions, and optional domain targets such as lists or tasks. FK relations intentionally use non-cascading behaviors to preserve audit records when referenced entities are removed.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Acting administrator {@link todo_app_admin.id}. Nullable so audit persists when admin account removed.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_admin_session_id
foreignFields.description: Admin session used for the action {@link todo_app_admin_sessions.id}. Nullable to preserve record when session removed.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todouser_id
foreignFields.description: Acting user (owner or collaborator) {@link todo_app_todouser.id}. Nullable so audit persists when user account removed.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todouser_session_id
foreignFields.description: User session used for the action {@link todo_app_todouser_sessions.id}. Nullable to preserve record when session removed.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_list_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced list (when applicable) {@link todo_app_lists.id}. Nullable so audit persists when lists are deleted or purged.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_task_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced task (when applicable) {@link todo_app_tasks.id}. Nullable so audit persists when tasks are deleted or purged.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Canonical event type (e.g., 'export','delete','visibility_change','moderation_action').

plainFields.name: target_type
plainFields.description: Polymorphic target type when applicable (e.g., 'list','task','invitation').

plainFields.name: target_id
plainFields.description: Polymorphic target id when applicable.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Free-text details or JSON payload (stored as text) describing the event for forensic analysis.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Source IP address for the event.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Optional request URL or resource href associated with the event.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent string captured at time of event.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Event ingestion time (snapshot timestamp).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last-updated time for operational corrections.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for the audit record (rare; used for legal redaction).

models.name: todo_app_admin_actions
models.description: Detailed record of administrator moderation actions and policy operations. Each record is authored by an admin and captures reason, target, and related session for compliance review and audit trails. Admin FK uses non-cascading semantics to preserve records.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Acting administrator {@link todo_app_admin.id}. Required. Use Restrict on delete to preserve moderation history and prevent accidental removal.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_admin_session_id
foreignFields.description: Admin session that initiated the action {@link todo_app_admin_sessions.id}. Nullable to preserve record when session removed.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todouser_id
foreignFields.description: Optional affected user account {@link todo_app_todouser.id}. Nullable to preserve record when affected account removed.

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: Administrative action code (e.g., 'suspend_account','remove_public_list','apply_legal_hold').

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Admin-supplied reason or policy code for the action.

plainFields.name: target_type
plainFields.description: Polymorphic target type for the admin action (e.g., 'list','task','account').

plainFields.name: target_id
plainFields.description: Polymorphic target id for the admin action.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Free-text details, investigative notes, or references to external case ids.

plainFields.name: audit_case_id
plainFields.description: Optional internal case identifier linking related moderation records.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Action timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification time for the record (e.g., annotation added).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for redaction or legal expiry.

models.name: todo_app_user_activity_logs
models.description: Append-only activity log capturing user interactions and behavioral events (login, logout, invitation responses, import/export requests). Designed for auditing, behavioral analysis, and security investigations. All actor FKs are nullable and use non-cascading semantics to preserve history even when source objects are removed.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todouser_id
foreignFields.description: Actor user {@link todo_app_todouser.id}. Nullable to retain activity logs when user account is removed.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todouser_session_id
foreignFields.description: User session for this activity {@link todo_app_todouser_sessions.id}. Nullable to preserve records when session removed.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_list_id
foreignFields.description: Optional list context for the activity {@link todo_app_lists.id}. Nullable to preserve logs when lists are purged.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_task_id
foreignFields.description: Optional task context for the activity {@link todo_app_tasks.id}. Nullable to preserve logs when tasks are purged.

plainFields.name: activity_type
plainFields.description: Activity code (e.g., 'login','logout','invite_accept','import_request','export_request').

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Optional free-text or structured payload (stored as text) describing the activity.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Source IP address for the activity.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Optional associated URL or request href.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Activity timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last-updated time for operational corrections.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for the log entry (used rarely for redaction).
